text:
Rahul: Quick heads-up — infra alerted that GPU pool refill slipped, which pushes our canary window ~2 weeks. Need to lock MVP cuts by EOD so milestone isn't moved.
Emily: Ugh. Which things are on the chopping block?
Rahul: Shortlist: embeddings cache (defer), advanced telemetry export (async post-launch), tenant-level feature flags (move to v1/dedicated). Keep core generation, model pinning, basic telemetry, canary path.
Sam: Agree deferring caching. Big infra lift. We can add an app-side LRU as temp if customers hit perf.
Liz: Design: removing tenant flags affects ACME pilot SSO flows. ACME said a staging workaround for 2 weeks is tolerable if we document it.
Jose: Proposal: keep tenant flags behind a Dedicated-only feature gate. Reduces the hosted launch surface and keeps pilot customers happy.
ops-bot: [Alert] GPU pool droplet-3 at 82% utilization — refill ETA +10 days.
Emily: If we gate flags, QA matrix grows. How many extra tests? can we parallelize?
Sam: Roughly +3 sprint-equivalent effort for gated rollout test coverage. If we cut it now, adding it back post-launch ~1 sprint.
Rahul: My proposal: Lock "MVP-core" = generation, model pinning, basic telemetry, hosted canary. Move tenant flags + embeddings cache into an "MVP-alpha" post-launch lane (target +2 weeks after canary). Sound ok?
Liz: +1 from design if we ship an ACME staging checklist and UI notes.
Jose: +1. Also need updated runbook & release notes for sales.
Rahul: I'll update the GH milestone and ping sales & ACME. Current cutlist to be applied:
- tenant-level feature flags
- embeddings cache
- advanced export pipelines
- campaign analytics dashboard (non-blocking)
Plan: canary target 2026-04-05, full launch window unaffected if no other blockers.
Emily: Ack — I'll rebaseline QA board and adjust test windows.
Rahul: Thanks — unless objections by 3pm PT I'll lock the milestone and send the cutlist to stakeholders. @liz @jose :thumbsup:
